newsitem.title: UK: IOC buys four Dubais in November buying tender.
newsitem.headline: IOC buys four Dubais in November buying tender.

text.p: Indian Oil Corp (IOC) bought four cargoes of Dubai crude in its November buying tender, crude traders said.
It was not immediately clear whether IOC bought any of the other crude grades -- Nigerian Qua Iboe or Egyptian Suez Blend -- offered into the tender.
IOC bought the 500,000 Dubai cargoes from Conoco at first half November Dubai quotes +41 cents, Phibro at +43 cents, Total at +44 cents and Vitol at +45 cents.
Not all the companies were immediately able to confirm the awards.
Eight Dubai cargoes in total were offered into the tender.
IOC in addition was expected to buy from the seven VLCCs of Qua Iboe and two Suez Blend cargoes offered in the tender.
